speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore arise, you and all these people, and cross over the Jordan into the land that I am giving to the children of Israel.

speaker: god
text: I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread, just as I promised to Moses.

speaker: god
text: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.

speaker: god
text: No one shall stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so will I be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

speaker: god
text: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give these people the inheritance of the land that I swore to their fathers I would give them.

speaker: god
text: Above all, be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe all the law that My servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may prosper wherever you go.

speaker: god
text: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.

speaker: god
text: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Prepare your provisions, for within three days you will cross the Jordan to go in and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.’

speaker: officers
name: The officers of the people
text: Prepare your provisions, for within three days you will cross the Jordan to go in and take possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

speaker: joshua
text: Remember what Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you when he said, ‘The LORD your God will give you rest, and He will give you this land.’

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: The LORD your God will give you rest, and He will give you this land.
tag: Moses the servant of the LORD

speaker: joshua
text: Your wives, your young children, and your livestock may remain in the land that Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But all your mighty men of valor must be armed for battle to cross over ahead of your brothers and help them,

speaker: joshua
text: until the LORD gives them rest as He has done for you, and your brothers also possess the land that the LORD your God is giving them. Then you may return to the land of your inheritance and take possession of that which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the east side of the Jordan.

speaker: transjordan-tribes
name: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
text: Everything you have commanded us we will do, and everywhere you send us we will go.

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you. And may the LORD your God be with you, as He was with Moses.

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: Anyone who rebels against your order and does not obey your words, all that you command him, will be put to death. Above all, be strong and courageous!

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.

speaker: unnamed-informants
name: Unnamed informants
text: Behold, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.

speaker: king-of-jericho
name: The king of Jericho
text: Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.

speaker: rahab
name: Rahab
text: Yes, the men did come to me, but I did not know where they had come from.

speaker: rahab
text: At dusk, when the gate was about to close, the men went out, and I do not know which way they went. Pursue them quickly, and you may catch them!

speaker: rahab
text: I know that the LORD has given you this land and that the fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of you.

speaker: rahab
text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites across the Jordan, whom you devoted to destruction.

speaker: rahab
text: When we heard this, our hearts melted and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.

speaker: rahab
text: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD that you will indeed show kindness to my family, because I showed kindness to you. Give me a sure sign

speaker: rahab
text: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and that you will deliver us from death.

speaker: two-spies
name: The two spies
text: Our lives for your lives!

speaker: two-spies
text: If you do not report our mission, we will show you kindness and faithfulness when the LORD gives us the land.

speaker: rahab
text: Go to the hill country,

speaker: rahab
text: so that your pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned; then go on your way.

speaker: two-spies
text: We will not be bound by this oath you made us swear

speaker: two-spies
text: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother and brothers and all your family into your house.

speaker: two-spies
text: If anyone goes out the door of your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be innocent. But if a hand is laid on anyone with you in the house, his blood will be on our heads.

speaker: two-spies
text: And if you report our mission, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.

speaker: rahab
text: Let it be as you say,

speaker: two-spies
text: The LORD has surely delivered the entire land into our hands,

speaker: two-spies
text: Indeed, all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of us.

speaker: officers
name: The officers
text: When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, you are to set out from your positions and follow it.

speaker: officers
text: But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between yourselves and the ark. Do not go near it, so that you can see the way to go, since you have never traveled this way before.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

speaker: joshua
text: Take the ark of the covenant and go on ahead of the people.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.

speaker: god
text: Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the waters, stand in the Jordan.’

speaker: joshua
text: When you reach the edge of the waters, stand in the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.

speaker: joshua
text: This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that He will surely drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.

speaker: joshua
text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go ahead of you into the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: Now choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.

speaker: joshua
text: When the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD—the Lord of all the earth—touch down in the waters of the Jordan, its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,

speaker: god
text: and command them: ‘Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests were standing, carry them with you, and set them down in the place where you spend the night.’

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan where the priests were standing, carry them with you, and set them down in the place where you spend the night.

speaker: joshua
text: Cross over before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take a stone upon his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of Israel,

speaker: joshua
text: to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’

speaker: israelite-children
name: Israelite children
text: What do these stones mean to you?

speaker: joshua
text: you are to tell them, ‘The waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters were cut off.’ Therefore these stones will be a memorial to the Israelites forever.

speaker: israelites
name: The Israelites
text: The waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters were cut off.

speaker: god
text: Command the priests who carry the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: Come up from the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: In the future, when your children ask their fathers, ‘What is the meaning of these stones?’

speaker: israelite-children
text: What is the meaning of these stones?

speaker: joshua
text: you are to tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’

speaker: israelites
text: Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.

speaker: joshua
text: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed over, just as He did to the Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed over.

speaker: joshua
text: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty, and so that you may always fear the LORD your God.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel once again.

speaker: god
text: Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Are You for us or for our enemies?

speaker: commander-of-the-lords-army
name: The Commander of the LORD’s army
text: Neither,

speaker: commander-of-the-lords-army
text: I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army.

speaker: joshua
text: What does my Lord have to say to His servant?

speaker: commander-of-the-lords-army
text: Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.
tag: The Commander of the LORD’s army

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Behold, I have delivered Jericho into your hand, along with its king and its mighty men of valor.

speaker: god
text: March around the city with all the men of war, circling the city one time. Do this for six days.

speaker: god
text: Have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark. Then on the seventh day, march around the city seven times, while the priests blow the horns.

speaker: god
text: And when there is a long blast of the ram’s horn and you hear its sound, have all the people give a mighty shout. Then the wall of the city will collapse and all your people will charge straight into the city.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Take up the ark of the covenant and have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark of the LORD.

speaker: joshua
text: Advance and march around the city, with the armed troops going ahead of the ark of the LORD.

speaker: joshua
text: Do not give a battle cry or let your voice be heard; do not let one word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you are to shout!

speaker: joshua
text: Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!

speaker: joshua
text: Now the city and everything in it must be devoted to the LORD for destruction. Only Rahab the prostitute and all those with her in her house will live, because she hid the spies we sent.

speaker: joshua
text: But keep away from the things devoted to destruction, lest you yourself be set apart for destruction. If you take any of these, you will set apart the camp of Israel for destruction and bring disaster upon it.

speaker: joshua
text: For all the silver and gold and all the articles of bronze and iron are holy to the LORD; they must go into His treasury.

speaker: joshua
text: Go into the house of the prostitute and bring out the woman and all who are with her, just as you promised her.

speaker: joshua
text: Cursed before the LORD is the man who rises up and rebuilds this city, Jericho; at the cost of his firstborn he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Go up and spy out the land.

speaker: spies-to-ai
name: The men sent to spy out Ai
text: There is no need to send all the people; two or three thousand men are enough to go up and attack Ai. Since the people of Ai are so few, you need not wear out all our people there.

speaker: joshua
text: O, Lord GOD,

speaker: joshua
text: why did You ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be destroyed? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!

speaker: joshua
text: O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned its back and run from its enemies?

speaker: joshua
text: When the Canaanites and all who live in the land hear about this, they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Stand up! Why have you fallen on your face?

speaker: god
text: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed My covenant that I commanded them, and they have taken some of what was devoted to destruction. Indeed, they have stolen and lied, and they have put these things with their own possessions.

speaker: god
text: This is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies. They will turn their backs and run from their enemies, because they themselves have been set apart for destruction. I will no longer be with you unless you remove from among you whatever is devoted to destruction.

speaker: god
text: Get up and consecrate the people, saying, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Among you, O Israel, there are things devoted to destruction. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.

speaker: joshua
text: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Among you, O Israel, there are things devoted to destruction. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.

speaker: god
text: In the morning you must present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the LORD selects shall come forward clan by clan, and the clan that the LORD selects shall come forward family by family, and the family that the LORD selects shall come forward man by man.

speaker: joshua
text: In the morning you must present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the LORD selects shall come forward clan by clan, and the clan that the LORD selects shall come forward family by family, and the family that the LORD selects shall come forward man by man.

speaker: god
text: The one who is caught with the things devoted to destruction must be burned, along with all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and committed an outrage in Israel.’

speaker: joshua
text: The one who is caught with the things devoted to destruction must be burned, along with all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and committed an outrage in Israel.

speaker: joshua
text: My son, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and make a confession to Him. I urge you to tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me.

speaker: achan
name: Achan
text: It is true,

speaker: achan
text: I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel. This is what I did:

speaker: achan
text: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.

speaker: joshua
text: Why have you brought this trouble upon us?

speaker: joshua
text: Today the LORD will bring trouble upon you!

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Do not be afraid or discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. See, I have delivered into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.

speaker: god
text: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set up an ambush behind the city.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Pay attention. You are to lie in ambush behind the city, not too far from it. All of you must be ready.

speaker: joshua
text: Then I and all the troops with me will advance on the city. When they come out against us as they did the first time, we will flee from them.

speaker: joshua
text: They will pursue us until we have drawn them away from the city, for they will say, ‘The Israelites are running away from us as they did before.’ So as we flee from them,

speaker: people-of-ai
name: The men of Ai
text: The Israelites are running away from us as they did before.

speaker: joshua
text: you are to rise from the ambush and seize the city, for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

speaker: joshua
text: And when you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do as the LORD has commanded! See, I have given you orders.

speaker: god
text: Hold out your battle lance toward Ai, for into your hand I will deliver the city.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: an altar of uncut stones on which no iron tool has been used.
tag: the Book of the Law of Moses

speaker: people-of-gibeon
name: The people of Gibeon
text: We have come from a distant land; please make a treaty with us.

speaker: israelites
name: The men of Israel
text: Perhaps you dwell near us. How can we make a treaty with you?

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: We are your servants,

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Who are you and where have you come from?

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: Your servants have come from a very distant land,

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: because of the fame of the LORD your God. For we have heard the reports about Him: all that He did in Egypt,

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: So the elders and inhabitants of our land told us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go to meet them and say to them: We are your servants. Please make a treaty with us.’

speaker: elders-and-inhabitants-of-gibeon
name: The elders and inhabitants of Gibeon
text: Take provisions for your journey; go to meet them and say to them: We are your servants. Please make a treaty with us.
tag: the elders and inhabitants of our land

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But take a look, it is now dry and moldy.

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: These wineskins were new when we filled them, but look, they are cracked. And these clothes and sandals are worn out from our very long journey.

speaker: leaders-of-israel
name: The leaders of the congregation
text: We have sworn an oath to them by the LORD, the God of Israel, and now we cannot touch them.

speaker: leaders-of-israel
text: This is how we will treat them: We will let them live, so that no wrath will fall on us because of the oath we swore to them.

speaker: leaders-of-israel
text: Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers for the whole congregation.

speaker: joshua
text: Why did you deceive us by telling us you live far away from us, when in fact you live among us?

speaker: joshua
text: Now therefore you are under a curse and will perpetually serve as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God.

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: Your servants were told clearly that the LORD your God had commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land and wipe out all its inhabitants before you. So we greatly feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we have done this.

speaker: people-of-gibeon
text: Now we are in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you.

speaker: adoni-zedek
name: Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem
text: Come up and help me. We will attack Gibeon, because they have made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.

speaker: people-of-gibeon
name: The men of Gibeon
text: Do not abandon your servants. Come quickly and save us! Help us, because all the kings of the Amorites from the hill country have joined forces against us.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Do not be afraid of them, for I have delivered them into your hand. Not one of them shall stand against you.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: O sun, stand still over Gibeon, O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.

speaker: book-of-jashar
name: The Book of Jashar
text: So the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.

speaker: unnamed-informants
name: Unnamed informants
text: The five kings have been found; they are hiding in the cave at Makkedah.

speaker: joshua
text: Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and post men there to guard them.

speaker: joshua
text: But you, do not stop there. Pursue your enemies and attack them from behind. Do not let them reach their cities, for the LORD your God has delivered them into your hand.

speaker: joshua
text: Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me.

speaker: joshua
text: Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.

speaker: joshua
text: Do not be afraid or discouraged,

speaker: joshua
text: Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all the enemies you fight.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Do not be afraid of them, for by this time tomorrow I will deliver all of them slain before Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn up their chariots.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: You are old and well along in years, but very much of the land remains to be possessed.

speaker: god
text: This is the land that remains:

speaker: god
text: All the territory of the Philistines and the Geshurites, from the Shihor east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north (considered to be Canaanite territory)—that of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, as well as that of the Avvites;

speaker: god
text: to the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Mearah of the Sidonians to Aphek, as far as the border of the Amorites;

speaker: god
text: the land of the Gebalites; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath.

speaker: god
text: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim—all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive out before the Israelites. Be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel, as I have commanded you.

speaker: god
text: Now therefore divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

speaker: caleb
name: Caleb
text: You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh-barnea about you and me.
tag: Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite

speaker: caleb
text: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back to him an honest report.

speaker: caleb
text: Although my brothers who went with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear, I remained loyal to the LORD my God.

speaker: caleb
text: On that day Moses swore to me, saying, ‘Surely the land on which you have set foot will be an inheritance to you and your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Surely the land on which you have set foot will be an inheritance to you and your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.

speaker: caleb
text: Now behold, as the LORD promised, He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old,

speaker: caleb
text: still as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. As my strength was then, so it is now for war, for going out, and for coming in.

speaker: caleb
text: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities. Perhaps with the LORD’s help I will drive them out, as the LORD has spoken.

speaker: caleb
name: Caleb
text: To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.

speaker: caleb
text: What do you desire?

speaker: acsah
name: Acsah
text: Give me a blessing,

speaker: acsah
text: Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.

speaker: daughters-of-zelophehad
name: The daughters of Zelophehad
text: The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.

speaker: sons-of-joseph
name: The sons of Joseph
text: Why have you given us only one portion as an inheritance? We have many people, because the LORD has blessed us abundantly.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: If you have so many people that the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go to the forest and clear for yourself an area in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim.

speaker: sons-of-joseph
text: The hill country is not enough for us,

speaker: sons-of-joseph
text: and all the Canaanites who live in the valley have iron chariots, both in Beth-shean with its towns and in the Valley of Jezreel.

speaker: joshua
text: You have many people and great strength. You shall not have just one allotment,

speaker: joshua
text: because the hill country will be yours as well. It is a forest; clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours. Although the Canaanites have iron chariots and although they are strong, you can drive them out.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: How long will you put off entering and possessing the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?

speaker: joshua
text: Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land and map it out, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me

speaker: joshua
text: and divide the land into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north.

speaker: joshua
text: When you have mapped out the seven portions of land and brought it to me, I will cast lots for you here in the presence of the LORD our God.

speaker: joshua
text: The Levites, however, have no portion among you, because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD. And Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received the inheritance that Moses the servant of the LORD gave them beyond the Jordan to the east.

speaker: joshua
text: Go and survey the land, map it out, and return to me. Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,

speaker: god
text: so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there. These will be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

speaker: god
text: When someone flees to one of these cities, stands at the entrance of the city gate, and states his case before its elders, they are to bring him into the city and give him a place to live among them.

speaker: god
text: Now if the avenger of blood pursues him, they must not surrender the manslayer into his hand, because that man killed his neighbor accidentally without prior malice.

speaker: god
text: He is to stay in that city until he stands trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest serving at that time. Then the manslayer may return to his own home in the city from which he fled.

speaker: family-heads-of-levites
name: The family heads of the Levites
text: The LORD commanded through Moses that we be given cities in which to live, together with pasturelands for our livestock.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: You have done all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and you have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you.

speaker: joshua
text: All this time you have not deserted your brothers, up to this very day, but have kept the charge given you by the LORD your God.

speaker: joshua
text: And now that the LORD your God has given your brothers rest as He promised them, you may return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you across the Jordan.

speaker: joshua
text: But be very careful to observe the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you: to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, to keep His commandments, to hold fast to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

speaker: joshua
text: Return to your homes with your great wealth, with immense herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze, iron, and very many clothes. Divide with your brothers the spoil of your enemies.

speaker: unnamed-informants
name: Unnamed informants
text: Behold, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar on the border of the land of Canaan, at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side.

speaker: phinehas-and-chiefs
name: Phinehas and the ten chiefs
text: This is what the whole congregation of the LORD says: ‘What is this breach of faith you have committed today against the God of Israel by turning away from the LORD and building for yourselves an altar, that you might rebel against the LORD this day?

speaker: israelites
name: The whole congregation of the LORD
text: What is this breach of faith you have committed today against the God of Israel by turning away from the LORD and building for yourselves an altar, that you might rebel against the LORD this day?
tag: the whole congregation of the LORD

speaker: phinehas-and-chiefs
text: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day? It even brought a plague upon the congregation of the LORD.

speaker: israelites
text: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day? It even brought a plague upon the congregation of the LORD.

speaker: phinehas-and-chiefs
text: And now, would you turn away from the LORD? If you rebel today against the LORD, tomorrow He will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

speaker: israelites
text: And now, would you turn away from the LORD? If you rebel today against the LORD, tomorrow He will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

speaker: phinehas-and-chiefs
text: If indeed the land of your inheritance is unclean, then cross over to the land of the LORD’s possession, where the LORD’s tabernacle stands, and take possession of it among us. But do not rebel against the LORD or against us by building for yourselves an altar other than the altar of the LORD our God.

speaker: israelites
text: If indeed the land of your inheritance is unclean, then cross over to the land of the LORD’s possession, where the LORD’s tabernacle stands, and take possession of it among us. But do not rebel against the LORD or against us by building for yourselves an altar other than the altar of the LORD our God.

speaker: phinehas-and-chiefs
text: Was not Achan son of Zerah unfaithful regarding what was set apart for destruction, bringing wrath upon the whole congregation of Israel? Yet it was not only Achan who perished because of his sin!’

speaker: israelites
text: Was not Achan son of Zerah unfaithful regarding what was set apart for destruction, bringing wrath upon the whole congregation of Israel? Yet it was not only Achan who perished because of his sin!

speaker: transjordan-tribes
name: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
text: The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! He knows, and may Israel also know. If this was in rebellion or breach of faith against the LORD, do not spare us today.

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: If we have built for ourselves an altar to turn away from Him and to offer burnt offerings and grain offerings on it, or to sacrifice fellowship offerings on it, may the LORD Himself hold us accountable.

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: But in fact we have done this for fear that in the future your descendants might say to ours, ‘What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?

speaker: israelite-descendants
name: Future descendants of the western tribes
text: What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you Reubenites and Gadites. You have no share in the LORD!’ So your descendants could cause ours to stop fearing the LORD.

speaker: israelite-descendants
text: For the LORD has made the Jordan a border between us and you Reubenites and Gadites. You have no share in the LORD!

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: That is why we said, ‘Let us take action and build an altar for ourselves, but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: Let us take action and build an altar for ourselves, but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: Rather, let it be a witness between us and you and the generations to come, that we will worship the LORD in His presence with our burnt offerings, sacrifices, and peace offerings.’ Then in the future, your descendants cannot say to ours, ‘You have no share in the LORD!’

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: Rather, let it be a witness between us and you and the generations to come, that we will worship the LORD in His presence with our burnt offerings, sacrifices, and peace offerings.

speaker: israelite-descendants
text: You have no share in the LORD!

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: Therefore we said, ‘If they ever say this to us or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the altar of the LORD that our fathers made, not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.’

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: If they ever say this to us or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the altar of the LORD that our fathers made, not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.

speaker: transjordan-tribes
text: Far be it from us to rebel against the LORD and turn away from Him today by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings, or sacrifices, other than the altar of the LORD our God, which stands before His tabernacle.

speaker: phinehas
name: Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest
text: Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this breach of faith against Him. Consequently, you have delivered the Israelites from the hand of the LORD.
tag: Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest

speaker: reubenites-and-gadites
name: The Reubenites and Gadites
text: It is a witness between us that the LORD is God.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: I am old and well along in years,

speaker: joshua
text: and you have seen everything that the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake, because it was the LORD your God who fought for you.

speaker: joshua
text: See, I have allotted as an inheritance to your tribes these remaining nations, including all the nations I have already cut off, from the Jordan westward to the Great Sea.

speaker: joshua
text: The LORD your God will push them out of your way and drive them out before you, so that you can take possession of their land, as the LORD your God promised you.

speaker: joshua
text: Be very strong, then, so that you can keep and obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, not turning aside from it to the right or to the left.

speaker: joshua
text: So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.

speaker: joshua
text: Instead, you shall hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

speaker: joshua
text: The LORD has driven out great and powerful nations before you, and to this day no one can stand against you.

speaker: joshua
text: One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as He promised.

speaker: joshua
text: Therefore watch yourselves carefully, that you love the LORD your God.

speaker: joshua
text: For if you turn away and cling to the rest of these nations that remain among you, and if you intermarry and associate with them,

speaker: joshua
text: know for sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become for you a snare and a trap, a scourge in your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land that the LORD your God has given you.

speaker: joshua
text: Now behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know with all your heart and soul that not one of the good promises the LORD your God made to you has failed. Everything was fulfilled for you; not one promise has failed.

speaker: joshua
text: But just as every good thing the LORD your God promised you has come to pass, likewise the LORD will bring upon you the calamity He has threatened, until He has destroyed you from this good land He has given you.

speaker: joshua
text: If you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from this good land He has given you.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Long ago your fathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Long ago your fathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.
tag: the LORD, the God of Israel

speaker: joshua
text: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants. I gave him Isaac,

speaker: god
text: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants. I gave him Isaac,

speaker: joshua
text: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

speaker: god
text: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

speaker: joshua
text: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.

speaker: god
text: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.

speaker: joshua
text: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt and you reached the Red Sea, the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.

speaker: god
text: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt and you reached the Red Sea, the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.

speaker: joshua
text: So your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them. Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.

speaker: god
text: So your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them. Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.

speaker: joshua
text: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan. They fought against you, but I delivered them into your hand, that you should possess their land when I destroyed them before you.

speaker: god
text: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan. They fought against you, but I delivered them into your hand, that you should possess their land when I destroyed them before you.

speaker: joshua
text: Then Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

speaker: god
text: Then Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

speaker: joshua
text: but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.

speaker: god
text: but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.

speaker: joshua
text: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.

speaker: god
text: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.

speaker: joshua
text: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.

speaker: god
text: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.

speaker: joshua
text: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’

speaker: god
text: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.

speaker: joshua
text: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

speaker: joshua
text: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!

speaker: israelites
name: The people
text: Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!

speaker: israelites
text: For the LORD our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and performed these great signs before our eyes. He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

speaker: israelites
text: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because He is our God!

speaker: joshua
text: You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.

speaker: joshua
text: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods, He will turn and bring disaster on you and consume you, even after He has been good to you.

speaker: israelites
text: No!

speaker: israelites
text: We will serve the LORD!

speaker: joshua
text: You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.

speaker: israelites
text: We are witnesses!

speaker: joshua
text: Now, therefore,

speaker: joshua
text: get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.

speaker: israelites
text: We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice.

speaker: joshua
text: You see this stone. It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us, and it will be a witness against you if you ever deny your God.
